title: Toolbox search sites
description: The sites a track with no download link offers a search on, one lettered badge each. The shipped list is search-sites.json next to this file; a site somebody adds in settings has the same shape, and so does each entry of an exported state file's `searchSites`. A badge opens a tab and never fetches, so a site needs no host permission.

$schema.description: This schema, for an editor to check the file against.

sites.description: The sites, in the order their badges are drawn.

site.description: One site. The reader drops an entry this refuses rather than drawing a badge that does nothing.

id.description: What the badge's switch is remembered under (localStorage `pref:search:<id>`). Renaming it forgets whether the badge was switched off.

name.description: The site's own name, as settings and the panel's hints say it.

badge.description: The characters on the badge. It is 28px wide, so three at most.

url.description: The search address: https, with at least one of {artist}, {title} or {query} in it, each URL-encoded where it lands. Any other {word} is refused rather than searched for.

background.description: The badge's colour. Without one the badge is grey.

color.description: The ink on the badge. Without one it is white.

on.description: false ships the badge switched off. Absent means on.

colour.description: A hex colour, #rgb to #rrggbbaa: these land in a style attribute, so nothing else is taken.
